pkgmetadata.longdescription: A QindaTK desktop app that follows the system journal in real time for break-in attempts (password guessing over SSH, logins after failed guesses, port scans, wrong administrator and lock-screen passwords, new accounts and administrator rights) and explains each in plain English with what to do. Manages ufw or its own nftables table through a small pkexec helper that cannot lock the owner out.
